exposure: Mode of delivery in previous pregnancy
Women with previous elective cesarean delivery
Women with previous emergency cesarean delivery
cohort: 192,057 women who had a vaginal delivery of a singleton, term, cephalic infant
finding: Women undergoing vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) following a previous emergency cesarean section had a higher rate of obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) compared to primiparous women.
mod_finding: Women undergoing VBAC after emergency cesarean had a higher rate of OASI compared to primiparous women.
